stemMd: What did the museum do with the removed threshold?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It concealed every record of the replacement

options.label: B

options.label: C

explanationMd: The material was retained in the collection, and the replacement was explained publicly. This preserved the object and some of its history while changing its physical role in the building.

distractorRationale.c: The passage says it was retained.
distractorRationale.b: The replacement remained the response to the access problem.
